provenance.fit: CMA-ES per instance from the global fit, 60 s episodes at one perturbation seed per instance, 32 episodes per instance (population 8, 4 generations)

fields.seed: the perturbation seed of the fit
fields.u: the fitted parameters, in the order of 'parameters', as stored (see README)
fields.best_ang: minimum angle (degrees) reached by the fit's best episode on that machine. The paper's table comes from one separate 60-second run of these parameters followed by post-optimization, so its angle can differ from this one in either direction
